props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the input.

props.name: disabled

props.name: formatOptions

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the number input. Useful for composition.

props.name: inputMode
props.description:
Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user. It also determines
the type of keyboard shown to the user on mobile devices

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the number input value is invalid.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Shift` key is held.

props.name: locale
props.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

props.name: max

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the number input

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the number input. Useful for form submission.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Function invoked when the number input is focused

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function invoked when the value changes

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Function invoked when the value is committed (when the input is blurred or the Enter key is pressed)

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Function invoked when the value overflows or underflows the min/max range

props.name: pattern
props.description: The pattern used to check the <input> element's value against

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the number input is readonly

props.name: required

props.name: smallStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Alt` key is held.

props.name: spinOnPress
props.description: Whether to spin the value when the increment/decrement button is pressed

props.name: step
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states
